messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty page fired: INC-202642 - embeddings queue latency spike in eu-west-1 (auto-escalate)
joel-oncall: I'm on it :raised_hand: taking ownership and jumping into the bridge
pagerbot: PagerDuty: Incident INC-202642 acknowledged by joel-oncall
maria-dev: quick triage: p95/p99 trending up for embed calls, p50 fine. grabbing logs now
```text
2026-03-17T09:02:15Z [embedder] kv_cache_evictions=124 spike=true pool=hosted-eu-west-1
2026-03-17T09:02:17Z [rpc] latency_ms=1795 model=redwood-embed-small
2026-03-17T09:02:18Z [router] routed_to=hosted-eu-west-1 weight=0.6
```
samir-sre: looks like KV cache thrash + routing concentration to hosted pool. Recommend short-term: scale dedicated-pool-eu-1 + enable routing override to distribute load. I can kick that if joel ok
joel-oncall: do it. also set prefix caching ttl=60s for embeds path while we stabilize
ops-automation: auto-scaler: scaling dedicated-pool-eu-1 requested by joel-oncall -> +2 GPU nodes (initiated)
maria-dev: routing override applied: prefer dedicated-pool-eu-1 weight=0.8. metrics show initial p99 drop
elaine-cs: CS: we have 3 inbound tickets from EU customers reporting slow responses (two Pro, one Dedicated). Customers asked for ETA. Any quick line I can send?
joel-oncall: send: "We're aware of elevated embeddings latency in eu-west-1. Mitigation (scaling & routing) in progress; estimated stabilization ~10 minutes. We'll update in 10m or sooner." Tagging @elaine-cs for follow-ups
samir-sre: after scale p99 ~320ms, p95 ~120ms. KV eviction rate still elevated but trending down. Starting a cache warmup run to repopulate hot prefixes
maria-dev: warmup job kicked: `POST /ops/embeds/warmup?pool=dedicated-pool-eu-1` (background task)
elaine-cs: PSA posted to affected customers with joel's ETA :white_check_mark:
joel-oncall: status update: mitigation in place, performance returning to baseline. keeping this oncall for 30m to verify stability. Assigning post-incident owners: maria-dev (root-cause & fix), samir-sre (infra tuning & runbook updates), joel-oncall (ops & comms)
maria-dev: next steps I will: 1) run load replay vs cached vs uncached, 2) tune cache thresholds, 3) propose routing policy tweak for short bursts
samir-sre: infra tasks: 1) add eviction-alert threshold, 2) add warmup hook to autoscaler for new nodes, 3) patch autoscaler to consider kv_cache pressure
incidentbot: PagerDuty: INC-202642 status -> acknowledged -> in progress -> mitigation applied
joel-oncall: final: monitoring for the next 30m. If regression occurs, re-open INC-202642 and escalate. Thanks for the quick responses, team :tada:
